Associate Scientist USP/DSP Eurofins Leiden, Netherlands Job Description 
As an Associate Scientist you are involved in both upstream (USP) and downstream (DSP) studies to support the development and optimization of bioprocesses to produce therapeutic proteins and other biologics. You are responsible for performing practical laboratory work and you are expected to contribute to data processing and reporting. You will act as a practical lead in the lab for studies and, together with the project team, help complete studies within agreed timelines. You are also involved in improvements within the department, and expected to volunteer ideas and follow-up these ideas.
